move: two title scenes swap through a pixel grid popping cell by cell
how: Two offscreen canvases each draw a landscape image with a slow sine zoom, a dark wash and a centred title and subline (Before / After). The output holds scene A for 0.15 D, dissolves to B over 0.35 D, holds B, then dissolves back. Each 40px cell has a seeded threshold biased along a top-left to bottom-right diagonal; when the eased progress passes a cell threshold the incoming cell pops in from its centre with a cubic ease over a 12% window, flashed white as it lands, so the wipe travels while staying speckled.
adapt: Replace the two images, titles and sublines, cell size CW/CH, and the diagonal bias to change the wipe direction. Keep the 12% per-cell pop window and the white flash for the pixel feel.
port: mount(el, shot) creates the output and two scene canvases, loads images and builds the threshold table; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one linear progress tween over D whose onUpdate draws both scenes and the cell dissolve, replacing fx.register. Wait for image decode and fonts before the first frame.
caveats: scene zoom uses raw sin(t), about 2% scale mismatch at the loop boundary
canvas text depends on the fonts being loaded; the original only relies on document.fonts.ready
